scope: Approved knowledge notes, explicit claim disagreement and consistent task memory reads; engineering behavior, not measured model gains

contracts.migration: Adds nullable knowledge_json without rewriting legacy records, approval/intent/audit JSON or hashes; old writer must stop before upgrade.
contracts.knowledge: Bounded attributed applicability/counterexamples and explicit key/value; no lexical proof of applicability.
contracts.disagreement: Group differing explicit claim values from current owner/scope private active records before query/top-K; show complete group or bounded marker without unilateral body.
contracts.readView: Deferred read savepoint shares hits, tokens, standing records and partners; peer WAL writer can commit and next read sees its result.

limitations: No real-model gain, hidden holdout, production browser approval or cross-day result claimed.
Explicit key/value disagreement is not general semantic contradiction detection.
Applicability notes require current evidence; neither keyword hits nor user confirmation prove present applicability.
Snapshot budget may omit record bodies and some references, reported explicitly; no automatic conflict resolution.
Read-view consistency does not erase historical snapshots or instantly observe writes after the read begins.
Semantic tool-result compression and same-budget real model comparisons remain outstanding.

fullCheck.preparation: Removed all 28 generated lib directories after checking no symlinks or tracked files.
fullCheck.memoryPackInspection: Includes lib/knowledge.js and .d.ts, README, LICENSE, cordis.patch.yml; no tests or SQLite data.

performance.scope: Local synthetic snapshot latency only, not model quality or a production service-level guarantee.
performance.change: Per-claim Set uses the exact same dedup key once per record instead of repeatedly serializing earlier group members. Final ID sorting remains unchanged.
performance.assertion: All samples retained the 1000-record disagreement marker and selected no unilateral value.
performance.reproduce: Replace <workspace> in script import with absolute repository path; build personal-memory, save script as .mjs and run node. Before measurement used store.ts SHA 3b5677f4640e4486f81af264f5826d9c1e56e4cc767a20af6d5289c2dd2f9ebb; after uses sourceSha256.

independentReview.scope: Read-only review of metadata persistence/approval/migration, private visible disagreement groups, budget markers, read consistency, Set equivalence, current source hashes and actual check-v3 evidence.
independentReview.limitations: Deterministic native adapter coverage does not establish real-model gains, hidden holdout results or long-term effects.
